line.comment: * Updates the tax efficiency of this Outpost.
* Called every 30 minutes by Mayhem.Task.Station.Outpost.
* Tax efficiency uses a P-controller which approaches the efficiency target. It is represented using 5 digits. Example: 21343 = 213.43%
* Base efficiency target is 1000.00%.
* -50.00% efficiency for every owned sector (small empires grow faster)
* -100.00% efficiency X average jump distance to other sectors (well connected empires grow faster. A direct jump beacon route counts as 1 jump)
* +2.00% (was 3.03%) efficiency for every local station, excluding this Outpost (more developed sectors grow faster)
* +20% efficiency target for local Jump Point.
* Expanded 2.2: Capital Shipyards increase the tax efficiency target by 50%.
* Expanded 2.2: Population increases tax productivity.
* Beyond 200, efficiency continues growing at a reduced rate.
* Maximum population factor: 200% at 1000 population.
* Expanded 2.2: Tax Perk increases the tax efficiency target by 25%.
* Tax efficiency is heavily throttled until the player completes nation goals.
* Expanded 2.2: Symmetric proportional tax efficiency controller.
* Actual efficiency converges toward its target in both directions.
* Each update closes approximately 10% of the remaining difference.
* Ensure progress when integer division truncates small adjustments.
* Negative efficiency represents the remaining initialization delay.
* Apply the Tax perk minimum.
* tutorial message.
* Add-Ons 1.3: No tutorial on insane. (1.8.1: Changed to display tutorial message at 1%+ efficiency rather than above 10%.)
* Outpost manager displays ratings regarding how well the current empire layout is for tax efficiency growth.
* Small empire is better
* close together or well connected with jump beacons is better
* more stations is better
